name: Nezha #67 — Phoenix of Defiance and Rebirth (Primordial Form)
description: When the heavens forged order and chained the flame, a spark broke free — unbound, untamed, alive. From that spark rose Nezha, the Phoenix of Defiance, whose wings tore through destiny’s veil. He dances on the edge of ruin and renewal, each motion a rebellion, each breath — rebirth. His heart burns with the wrath of creation, his spear sings in the language of storms. Through his fire, the world remembers: no chain can hold a soul born from the blaze.

attributes.value: Crimson, Gold, Black Steel, Ember Glow
